ValidationRule.description: FB-925: Site optional at Stage 1/2, required from 3-Quote on. Fires only on stage change or create (as DE_Opp_Stage1_Gate does) so pre-existing siteless opps at 3-Quote+ stay editable. 9-Lost exempt.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(Skip_Stage_Gate__c), ISBLANK(Target_Site__c), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName)), CASE(TEXT(StageName), '3-Quote', 3, '4-Negotiate', 4, '5-Won', 5, 0) >= 3 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Operation Site is required from Stage 3-Quote onwards. Select the site this opportunity will be delivered from.
